recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-37622 unless a future work group decision changes which SearchParameter.type codes may carry comparators.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive issue requested a SearchParameter StructureDefinition constraint that prohibits SearchParameter.comparator unless SearchParameter.type is number, date, quantity, or special, because comparators on string/token searches create ambiguous query strings.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #2138 applied the issue. Commit a3559a4a0773e71e3310a7671c084e72bedcf1e9 added invariant spd-3 to source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml, and merge commit 49ad1d9e6f8418767d40a0e63db6bc18786e2730 merged it.
additional_context: SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source still has spd-3 plus a condition on SearchParameter.comparator. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-07-18 record the 8-0-0 vote to limit comparators to number, date, quantity, and special. The originating Zulip thread confirms the string/token ambiguity and identifies FHIR-37623 as a companion Da Vinci Drug Formulary IG cleanup outside this core checkout.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already enforces comparator.empty() or type in ('number' | 'date' | 'quantity' | 'special') and wires SearchParameter.comparator to condition spd-3.
